title: Israel's War with Benjamin

questions.question: Where did the people of Israel assemble?
questions.explanation: Judges 20:1 (ESV): "...and the congregation assembled as one man to the LORD at Mizpah."

questions.question: Who told the assembly what happened?
options: The Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered
questions.correctAnswer: The Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered
questions.explanation: Judges 20:4 (ESV): "And the Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered and said..."

questions.question: How many men of Israel (excluding Benjamin) drew the sword?
questions.explanation: Judges 20:2 (ESV): "...400,000 men who drew the sword."

questions.question: Did the Benjaminites agree to hand over the worthless fellows of Gibeah?
questions.explanation: Judges 20:13 (ESV): "But the Benjaminites would not listen to the voice of their brothers, the people of Israel."

questions.question: Who did the Lord say should go up first against Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Judges 20:18 (ESV): "...And the LORD said, 'Judah shall go up first.'"

questions.question: How many times did Israel fight Benjamin before winning?
questions.explanation: Judges 20:21, 25, 29 (Defeated day 1, defeated day 2, victory day 3).

questions.question: How many Israelites fell on the first day?
questions.explanation: Judges 20:21 (ESV): "...and destroyed on that day 22,000 men of the Israelites."

questions.question: How many Israelites fell on the second day?
questions.explanation: Judges 20:25 (ESV): "...and destroyed 18,000 men of the people of Israel..."

questions.question: What strategy did Israel use on the third day?
questions.explanation: Judges 20:29 (ESV): "So Israel set men in ambush around Gibeah."

questions.question: How many Benjaminites fell on the third day?
questions.explanation: Judges 20:35 (ESV): "...The people of Israel destroyed 25,100 men of Benjamin that day..."

questions.question: Who was high priest in those days?
questions.explanation: Judges 20:28 (ESV): "and Phinehas the son of Eleazar, son of Aaron, ministered before it in those days..."

questions.question: Where was the ark of the covenant in those days?
questions.explanation: Judges 20:26-27 (ESV): "Then all the people... went up to Bethel... And the people of Israel inquired of the LORD (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days..."

questions.question: How many left-handed warriors were among the Benjaminites?
questions.explanation: Judges 20:16 (ESV): "Among all these were 700 chosen men who were left-handed; every one could sling a stone at a hair and not miss."

questions.question: What signal was used for the ambush?
options: A great cloud of smoke rising out of the city
questions.correctAnswer: A great cloud of smoke rising out of the city
questions.explanation: Judges 20:38 (ESV): "Now the appointed signal... was that when they made a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city..."

questions.question: How many Benjaminites escaped to the rock of Rimmon?
questions.explanation: Judges 20:47 (ESV): "But 600 men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon..."

key_verse_text: ...saying, “Shall we go out once more to battle against our brothers the people of Benjamin, or shall we cease?” And the LORD said, “Go up, for tomorrow I will give them into your hand.” (ESV)
